name: Dog Sled
summary: Wooden basket sled with a handlebar and curved runners, with a tow line in front; no dogs. For snow scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the runners stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 760 px wide and 450 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = the sled bounces and the tow line sways (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the tow line goes left

author: krakujs
